audience: marketers and operations teams using MailerCheck to review email verification

useCases.title: Check verification capacity
useCases.text: Read your connected account and remaining MailerCheck credits before submitting an email for verification.

useCases.title: Review list verification progress
useCases.text: Browse existing verification lists, then inspect a list’s processing status and aggregate result counts.

useCases.title: Verify a new email address
useCases.text: Confirm MailerCheck credit usage to submit one email for asynchronous verification. Keep its verification ID and read the status and result later, waiting between checks.
